texts: good. the query picks out the thing that is an ebb and is deep and leaves the answer slot open, which is the licensed shape for an open "what" ask (the same shape as "what does Bob do?"), so any identifying class stored for it binds. Two limits are ours, not your sentence's, and no rewording would remove them: an open answer slot also re-binds the words you supplied, so "ebb" and "deep" come back alongside a real answer, and we have to guess whether "deep ebb" was recorded split (an ebb that is deep) or fused as a single term of art.
